opening.argument: Judge, consider the purchase pathway alongside the video's forward-looking message. The description provides an affiliate link explicitly framed as a way to buy Bone, while the discussion presents a governance change intended to make rewards more sustainable over time. Those statements concern different tokens, so they do not amount to an explicit promise that buying Bone will profit. But the combination places a token-buying action next to a case for renewed confidence in this part of the market. That commercial context deserves weight when deciding whether the video merely informs viewers or steers them toward a purchase.
